description: The agent-facing text file has an exact byte layout: H1 (first, as llms.txt v2 requires), provenance comment, blockquote, cluster sections ordered by slug, an Other section for unclustered items, one blank line between blocks and nothing else. An item with no description repeats its title; a draft item appears nowhere. Without this pin two conforming writers emit different bytes and Level 0 is unreachable. The provenance header carries the AI-assistance statement of AGSC-06-15 as its last line, a constant of the specification and never authored; no value interpolated into the block may carry `-->` (AGSC-06-13a). Expected bytes are derived by hand from the rule text: block (2) is the provenance comment, whose header carries the line `bundle_version: <content version>` between `spec_version:` and `generated_at:` (AGSC-06-13a, AGSC-04-25). The value here is the branch-1 form of AGSC-04-25 — the tag on the built commit, `v1.4.0`.

reason: Withdrawn for 1.1.0 (2026-10-29). AGSC-06-13a now puts the blockquote summary straight after the H1 and the provenance comment after the summary, escapes the backslash, `[`, `]` and `(` in a link line, and lets a restricted node leave out the bundle_version line; the expected bytes of this case change in all three respects. Superseded by disc-0024.
